location_exception_reason: Prefabricated metal buildings are engineered structures sold as complete systems; buyer decision is driven by span, load capacity, and end-use (warehouse, factory, hangar), not geographic origin. Location in title adds no product intelligence.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Contractor') describe who sells, not what is being sold. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PEB Manufacturer' leaves a complete product description; the title remains meaningful and accurate.
